rows.notes: Test/trial production of the first two cell lines began 2026-09-22; serial production was expected spring 2026 and slipped (S12). Not commercial, so status stays under_construction and start_year is null (first commercial production year not yet known). Annual report (S1) lists the Hungary plant as under construction with the other in-progress projects. Nameplate up to 100 GWh/yr (EUR 7.34bn) (S11). No source gives a target year for 100 GWh; I searched (electrive, carnewschina, Hungarian press snippets); capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication year of the source stating the nameplate (CONVENTIONS fallback). capacity_by_year_json {2026:34}: first phase 34 GWh per CarNewsChina (S48, editor's statement, not a CATL figure; one source). v1 NMC/prismatic unconfirmed -> null (one 2023 article says Debrecen will make cylindrical cells). Module assembly has run since 2024 on imported cells (S12). Candidate routing (T026 Debrecen) is this same row.

Phase 1 40 GWh broke ground 2025-07-26; 'expected to be completed and put into operation next year' (2026) -> ref year 2026 from that completion/operation statement. No news dated after 2025-07 found in two Chinese and English searches; silence may mean quiet progress or slippage. Phase 2 has no capacity figure.

Fuding (county-level city under Ningde) is covered by the Fujian-government total of CATL bases 'in the city' (330 GWh built + 170 under construction/planned); that page does not name Fuding, so inclusion is an inference. CATL's annual report (S1) names the Fuding base among projects advanced in 2025 and its fundraising table shows the Fuding Times project reached 'ready for use' status 2024-12-01 (cninfo PDF, 15.2bn yuan fully invested). Fuding plan: 149 GWh total incl. 40 GWh sodium-ion phase 6 (S3). No separate capacity kept, so nothing is counted twice.

Phase arithmetic: phase 1 30 GWh (CATL 2023, in operation since 2023-10-27, S16) + phase 2 'Gui'an Phase II Expansion' 40 GWh of cells on completion per the May 2026 draft environmental-impact approval reported by EnergyTrend (S45) = 70 GWh. CATL's 2023 release said 60 GWh total, and a Jan 2026 signing was reported as 30 GWh phase 2 (that gov page returned 503, not used) - so 60 vs 70 conflict; I took the latest and most specific (EIA) filing. Phase 2 is at EIA stage, not under construction, so no under_construction status. capacity_ref_year 2026 = publication year of the source stating phase 2 (no target year given; I searched, CONVENTIONS fallback). installed_as_of is the commissioning date (no later update found); installed basis: company. start_year null (not quoted).

Phase arithmetic: 60 (phase 1, in production 2025-05-10) + 40 (phase 3, 2025-07-21) + 60 (phase 2, April 2026) = 160 (S4); Xinhua via Sina 2026-10-05 says all 160 GWh is in production (S5, ref year 2026 from that all-in-production statement). Phase numbering differs between reports but totals agree. capacity_by_year_json 2025 = 60+40. S5 does not name CATL; S4 describes the same Yanzhou base. Installed basis: government/press design capacity (建成产能). v1 chemistry unconfirmed -> null.

Phase arithmetic (cells): north plant phases 1-3 = 36 GWh + south plant phase 4 = 30 GWh (Liyang LY8 environmental filing, S37) + LY7 = 40 GWh design, in production 2025-08-29 (S27/S36; OFweek sums the three to ~106 GWh). Nameplate 146 = 106 built + LY8 40 GWh under construction (S36; city-government page says construction to finish end of March 2026, S38, though one report says still building in Aug 2026). The 126 GWh in v1/S26 (Feb 2021 Argus-based plan) was wrong: the EIA shows phase 4 = 30 not 40 GWh. LY9 (60 GWh, signed 2025-11-26, S33) is undated planned capacity and kept in notes only; total would be ~206 GWh. CS3 plant (15.6 GWh packs) excluded as pack. SAIC-CATL (时代上汽) Liyang JV is a separate site/operator (listed in CATL annual report) - not counted here. Installed basis: press/EIA design capacity (OFweek 2026-09, derived from government filings), not company effective capacity. Previously unresolved; now two press sources. HKEX prospectus PDF not machine-readable for me.

Phase arithmetic: the lead's draft sum 60 + 30 + 60 = 150 double counts. China Energy News (S34) says the first-stage project ('一期', 14bn yuan) is 60 GWh; Mysteel puts the whole base at ~14bn yuan too, and base phase 2 adds 30 GWh (S8), so 'project 1' = base phases 1+2 = 60 (30 + 30, phase 1's own 30 not quoted). The Zhongzhou Times 'project phase 2' adds 60 GWh (S10) = base phases 3+4 (under construction from 2025-03-21, 'completed and put into use by the end of October 2026', S31 -> ref year 2026). So nameplate = 60 + 60 = 120 (v1 value confirmed). Installed 60 = phases 1+2 (phase 1 from 2024-12, S31; phase 2 from 2025-09-30, S8); phases 3-4 partly in production from 2026-06 and ramping (S9) with no GWh, so 60 is a floor. Installed basis: government/press design capacity. A 150 figure would need a fifth 30 GWh block that no source shows.

HUB row for CATL's Ningde-city bases: 330 GWh built (Fujian government / China Daily, 2026-01-16). The same page adds 170 GWh 'under construction or planned' with no date split, so per the CONVENTIONS hub exception it is NOT put in nameplate (undated remainder in notes only); nameplate = 330 with ref year 2026 (publication year). Covers HQ/Jiaocheng-Dongqiao plants (Ningde Funing Times 宁德福宁时代, Ningde Jiaocheng Times 蕉城时代 - both named in CATL's annual report entity list) and the Fuding Shidai base (planned 149 GWh incl. 40 GWh sodium-ion phase 6, S3), which is merged here. Fuding inclusion is inferred (Fuding is a county-level city of Ningde). The Xiapu Times-FAW JV plant (Ningde city) has its own row and may or may not be inside the 330. Installed basis: government. Plausibility: CATL's own end-2025 figure is 772 GWh capacity and 321 GWh under construction (S1); local-government built capacity runs above the company figure and bottom-up sums exceed 772 (see summary). v1 coordinates/chemistry unconfirmed -> chemistry null.

cell production unconfirmed; module base per S22. is_cell_manufacturer=false so it drops out of cell aggregates. Kept (not removed) as instructed, with everything unconfirmed set to null. Evidence found: the original Lingang site is a MODULE base (S21; 'appears to be able to assemble only battery modules and does not have the capacity to produce cells', S22); the 80 GWh figure was an unconfirmed rumour; a separate 2.8bn yuan Lingang plant (350,000 m2) broke ground 2022-02 with no stated product or capacity (S22) and no later news was found in Chinese searches. CATL's 2025 annual report (S1 file) does not mention Lingang/Shanghai as a cell base; the claim that its 2025 HK listing counts Shanghai among 13 bases comes from a search snippet and the prospectus PDF could not be read. Status left null because the furthest stage reached for CELL production is unknown; ESCALATE.

ESCALATE (unresolved after 3 further Chinese searches and 2 opened pages). Probably operational at least in part (phase 1 lines handed over late 2023 per v1), but not evidenced; status kept at the best-supported under_construction. The separate ~80 GWh project and Ampace are handled as their own rows/CSV lines.

ESCALATE (capacity). Qinghai Times is named in CATL's 2025 annual report list of environmental-disclosure (emitting, i.e. operating) enterprises (S40) and Sina 2025-07-24 mentions its 15 GWh technical-renovation project (plan: production Aug 2025, S25) - status operational is supported. v1's 10.5 GWh (Qinghai government, Jan 2024) could not be re-opened (503 three times) and no other open page gives the site's capacity, so nameplate/installed are null. Small plant (~10-15 GWh); unclear whether the 15 GWh renovation adds to or replaces existing lines.

Phase arithmetic: 10 plants built = 270 GWh + Sichuan Times phase 10 (30 GWh, ~95% complete) = 300 (S6, Aug 2026). Nov 2025: 210 GWh after Times-Changan phase-1 expansion (S7). Reports differ by a month or two; ref year 2026 from the 'all 11 plants running in 2026' target. Installed basis: government/local press 建成产能 (CATL's own total is 772 GWh across all sites, so this is likely above the company's effective capacity). Hub: ~10 separately named plants (Sichuan Times, Times-Geely, Times-Changan) already stored as one row. v1 chemistry unconfirmed -> null.

Status corrected from my earlier under_construction: a Dec 2023 local report says phase-1 plant 1 'was completed and formally put into production in June' 2023 (S42) and CATL's 2025 annual report lists Yichun Times (宜春时代) among its consolidated environmental-disclosure enterprises (S39). Phase 1 = ~50 GWh (S43; 2022 Jiemian) and phase 2 = 70 GWh planned (undated, no start/ construction evidence found in two further Chinese searches) -> total plan 120 GWh, but only the 50 GWh phase is dated/started, so nameplate 50 (CONVENTIONS exception logic). capacity_ref_year 2022 = publication year of the source stating 50 GWh (no target year given; searched). Installed null: only 'plant 1' known (>10 GWh output expected in 2023); no GWh for built lines. v1's 70 GWh (Xinhua Dec 2024) could not be verified. Not escalated for stalled status; ESCALATE only that current capacity is unquantified.

Plan figure changed: 2021-22 press said 25 GWh for phase 1 (S19) but CATL's March 2026 fundraising announcement (via press, S46) describes the project as '规划新增...年产能约30GWh'; I used the later company figure (30). Phase 2 (full storage chain) has no GWh figure. Installed null: first stage producing and second stage partly built but no GWh stated. v1 chemistry unconfirmed -> null.

A single IWR report (May 2026, unopened) of up to 60 GWh by end-2026 is not used. installed null: no source states commissioned vs design capacity. v1 NMC/prismatic unconfirmed -> null.

No target year for the 50 GWh: press conflicts (production end-2026 vs ~2028; construction to finish March 2028) and I found no 2026 progress news; capacity_ref_year 2025 = publication year of the source stating the nameplate (CONVENTIONS fallback, searched twice). start_year null. 50/50 JV; one row only. Candidate routing (T026) refers to this row.

Aug 2026 report: 'quietly entered phased commercial operations' with trial runs continuing (S14); Nov 2026 just-auto: production has begun (S15). Phase arithmetic: initial phase 6.9 GWh/yr, scaling to 15 GWh (S15; no target year, searched; ref year 2026 = publication year of that source, fallback). installed 6.9 is phase-1 design capacity, not measured output (basis: press). Cells vs modules/packs: InvestorTrust says cells feed pack lines, just-auto says only 'EV battery'. v1 NMC and 70/30 split unconfirmed -> chemistry null, partners without percentages. Annual report (S1) lists the Indonesia battery chain among projects in progress. A 40 GWh minister figure is aspirational and ignored.
